instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Playfair Display' ONLY for H1, H2, H3 headings. Use 'Lato' for all body text.
Implement the 'Glassmorphism' header with a blur effect (backdrop-blur-md).
The Hero section must use the provided 'hero_doctor' image. Ensure it is high quality and properly positioned.
Use the 'bento_grid' layout for the Services section. Do not use a simple list.
The 'Contact' section must include a working form (visual only) and the Google Map placeholder.
Ensure the 'Floating WhatsApp' button is always visible on mobile and desktop.
Use the provided 'logo' in the header. Adjust height to fit h-16 or h-20 container.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic blue. Use #005EB8.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on form submission.
For the 'Patients' section, use the Shadcn Accordion component for FAQs.
Ensure the site is fully responsive. Mobile menu must be a Sheet or Dropdown.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-12, p-24).
No gradients on text unless specified.
Dark mode is NOT required. Focus on a pristine Light Mode.
